title: Thai-Style Smoky Tofu Patties
description: A fusion of Thai flavors with smoky tofu patties. Marinated in a mixture of smoky paprika and Filipino-style spices, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine tofu, smoky paprika, Filipino-style chili garlic sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, rice vinegar, and salt. Blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in chopped green onions. Let it sit for 10-15 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 4-6 patties, depending on the desired size.
Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the patties and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer the patties to the preheated oven and bake for an additional 10-12 minutes, until cooked through.
Serve with additional green onions and your favorite sides, such as steamed rice or roasted vegetables.
